findings.body: The new CLAUDECODE condition changes SDK checking and installation for Claude-worker projects, which neither per-item locking nor crash cleanup requires. Revert this setup expansion and its tests/test_codex_setup.py additions while retaining doctor cleanup and the reader lock integration. The diagnostic rewrites at doctor.py lines 129 and 132, their tests/test_setup.py changes, and tests/conftest.py's duplicate CLAUDECODE reset likewise serve no requirement assigned to this part.
findings.title: Simpler: unrelated doctor setup changes → existing setup behavior
